title: Six Years of PSU projections (Google Sheet)
provenance: Link supplied by the repository owner in chat on 2026-11-10. The sheet does not name its publisher. It matches the six-year PSU forecast-history tool PPS staff announced at the Nov 4 board meeting [YT:9kX3vnfRlvY@3:48:51], but that is not confirmed.
notes: Tab "6 years of PSU forecasts": long format (Standard=school, Report_Year=PSU edition, e.g. 2026 = 2026-27 report; School_Type; Program; Data_Type Actual/Forecast; Academic_Year; Enrollment). Report_Year 2021-2026. Tab "Historical enrollment": PPS October enrollment by school 1996-97 to 2025-26 with change columns.
